zhCN: 罗德岛的博士从石棺中醒来时，几乎失去了全部记忆，却保留着洞悉战局的头脑。博士很少亲自挥剑，而是以简短的指令调度同伴；战局需要时，博士会放任"巴别塔的恶灵"短暂苏醒，把全部智慧化为最锋利的战斗本能。
enGB: The Doctor of Rhodes Island awoke from the sarcophagus with nearly all memories lost, yet with a mind that reads the battlefield like an open book. Rarely raising a blade in person, the Doctor directs allies with brief orders — and when the battle demands it, lets the Specter of Babel wake, turning wisdom into the sharpest fighting instinct.

zhCN: 1 级起，博士获得战术指令法术书：以智力自发施法，每日法术位与已知指令数与术士相同；0 环指令为可无限施展的戏法。
enGB: From 1st level the Doctor gains the Tactical Orders spellbook: spontaneous Intelligence casting using the sorcerer's spells-per-day and spells-known tables; 0-level orders are at-will cantrips.

zhCN: 标记一名敌人：所有友军对它的攻击与伤害获得 +1 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，每 4 个圣武士等级再 +1（20 级 +6）。标记持续时间等于你的智力调整值（至少 1 轮）。同一时间只能维持一个标记。每日可用 3 + 智力调整值 次。
enGB: Mark one enemy: all allies gain a +1 insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on attack and damage rolls against it, plus +1 more per 4 paladin levels (+6 at 20th). The mark lasts a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Only one mark at a time. Usable 3 + Intelligence modifier times per day.

zhCN: 所有友军对该目标的攻击与伤害获得洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。
enGB: All allies gain an insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on attack and damage rolls against this target.

zhCN: 博士每日可使用集火 3 + 智力调整值 次。此能力与战术指令法术书一同替换惩戒邪恶。
enGB: The Doctor can use Focus Fire 3 + Intelligence modifier times per day. Together with the spellbook, this replaces smite evil.

zhCN: 博士克服{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}检定获得 +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，此{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}失效，且此类检定改为承受等于转移量的{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。此能力替换神恩。
enGB: +2 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}. While the Specter is active this {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is lost and such checks instead take a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} equal to the Transfer Value. This ability replaces divine grace.

zhCN: 博士克服{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}检定获得 +4 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，此{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}失效，且此类检定改为承受等于转移量的{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。此能力替换神恩。
enGB: +4 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}. While the Specter is active this {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is lost and such checks instead take a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} equal to the Transfer Value. This ability replaces divine grace.

zhCN: 博士克服{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}检定获得 +6 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，此{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}失效，且此类检定改为承受等于转移量的{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。此能力替换神恩。
enGB: +6 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}. While the Specter is active this {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is lost and such checks instead take a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} equal to the Transfer Value. This ability replaces divine grace.

zhCN: 博士克服{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}检定获得 +8 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，此{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}失效，且此类检定改为承受等于转移量的{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。此能力替换神恩。
enGB: +8 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}. While the Specter is active this {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is lost and such checks instead take a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} equal to the Transfer Value. This ability replaces divine grace.

zhCN: 博士将智力调整值（若为正）加到所有{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上（不具类型，可叠加）。巴别塔的恶灵生效期间减半；20 级后不再减半。
enGB: The Doctor adds their Intelligence modifier (if positive) as an untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on all {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}. Halved while the Specter is active; full again at 20th level.

zhCN: 10 尺内的友军获得指挥灵光。
enGB: Allies within 10 feet gain Aura of Command.

zhCN: 半径 10 尺灵光：博士与灵光内的友军{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}先攻检定{/g}获得 +1 胜任{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。博士失去意识或恶灵生效期间失效。此能力替换圣武士的施法能力。
enGB: 半径 10 尺灵光：博士与灵光内的友军攻击检定与先攻检定获得 +1 胜任加值。博士失去意识或恶灵生效期间失效。此能力替换圣武士的施法能力。

zhCN: 30 尺内的友军获得全军指令。
enGB: 30 尺内的友军获得全军指令。

zhCN: 指挥灵光扩大到 30 尺，{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}提高到 +2。此能力替换正义灵光。
enGB: 指挥灵光扩大到 30 尺，加值提高到 +2。此能力替换正义灵光。

zhCN: 每日次数与伤害不死生物的豁免 DC 改用智力调整值，其余同原版圣疗。
enGB: Uses per day and the DC against undead use the Intelligence modifier; otherwise as the paladin ability.

zhCN: 豁免 DC 改用智力调整值；每次消耗 2 次圣疗次数，其余同原版。
enGB: The DC uses the Intelligence modifier; each use consumes 2 lay-on-hands charges; otherwise unchanged.

zhCN: 恶灵生效期间，博士只能施放【恶灵】指令；源石技艺精通失效且法术穿透倒扣；指挥灵光与全军指令失效。
enGB: 恶灵生效期间，博士只能施放【恶灵】指令；源石技艺精通失效且法术穿透倒扣；指挥灵光与全军指令失效。

zhCN: 博士只能执行{g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}移动动作{/g}：无法攻击（包括{g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}借机攻击{/g}）、施法，或主动使用职业特性与物品。
enGB: The Doctor can only take move actions: no attacks (including {g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}attacks of opportunity{/g}), spellcasting, or active use of abilities or items.

zhCN: 博士的速度获得 +50 尺{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}（不具类型，可叠加）。
enGB: The Doctor gains a +50-foot untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to speed.

zhCN: 巴别塔的恶灵：敏捷形态
敏捷值获得等于转移量两倍的{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}；近战攻击与伤害用敏捷代替力量（取较高者）。
enGB: Bonus to Dexterity equal to twice the Transfer Value; melee attack and damage rolls use Dexterity instead of Strength (whichever is higher).

zhCN: 巴别塔的恶灵：体质形态
体质值获得等于转移量两倍的{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免{/g}随之提高。
enGB: Bonus to Constitution equal to twice the Transfer Value; {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} and Fortitude saves increase accordingly.

zhCN: 唤醒巴别塔的恶灵。结束后进入恶灵余波；可用"结束恶灵"提前结束。
enGB: Awaken the Specter of Babel. The Specter's Aftermath follows when it ends; use End the Specter to end it early.

zhCN: 唤醒巴别塔的恶灵。结束后进入恶灵余波；可用"结束恶灵"提前结束。
enGB: Awaken the Specter of Babel. The Specter's Aftermath follows when it ends; use End the Specter to end it early.

zhCN: 唤醒沉睡的另一个自己：开启时选择敏捷形态或体质形态，将一半的智力调整值转移为战斗本能。每日可维持 4 + 圣武士等级 + 智力调整值 轮。结束后进入 2 轮恶灵余波。此能力替换决意灵光。
enGB: Awaken the other self within: choose the Agile or Enduring Form, transferring half your Intelligence modifier into pure fighting instinct. Usable for 4 + paladin level + Intelligence modifier rounds per day. The Specter's Aftermath follows. This ability replaces aura of resolve.

zhCN: 转移量提高为全部智力调整值。敏捷形态获得反射闪避，体质形态获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g} 3/—（可与其他来源叠加）。
enGB: The Transfer Value becomes the full Intelligence modifier. Agile Form gains evasion; Enduring Form gains DR 3/— (stacking).

zhCN: 开启恶灵改为{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}；恶灵生效期间可以下达集火。
enGB: Activating the Specter becomes a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}; Focus Fire can be issued while it is active.

zhCN: 立刻结束巴别塔的恶灵，进入 2 轮恶灵余波。
enGB: End the Specter of Babel immediately and suffer its Aftermath for 2 rounds.
The Doctor and the Specter are one.

zhCN: 博士不再需要在指挥官与恶灵之间做出选择：恶灵生效期间可下达所有指令，冷静头脑与灵光完整生效；恶灵结束后不受余波限制并可立即再次开启，但仍获得 +50 尺速度。此能力替换神圣斗士。
enGB: The Doctor no longer has to choose: all orders remain available during the Specter, Cool Head and auras function at full strength; the Aftermath imposes no restriction and the Specter can be reactivated immediately, though the +50-foot speed remains. This ability replaces holy champion.

zhCN: 你洞悉目标的步调。你与友军对其进行的下一次{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}获得 +1 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}；同一生物同一轮只能受此效果影响一次。
enGB: You and your allies gain a +1 insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on the next {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack roll{/g} against it this round.

zhCN: 目标恢复 1 点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}。该指令无法{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}在 24 小时内受过本指令{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}的生物。
enGB: The target regains 1 hit point; cannot affect a creature healed by it in the last 24 hours.

zhCN: 24 小时内无法再次受益于医疗敷料。
enGB: Cannot benefit from field dressing again within 24 hours.

zhCN: 你获得察觉检定 +2 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。
悬浮信标照亮 20 尺半径。
enGB: Illusion (light); 30 ft.; 10 min./level. A floating beacon lights a 20-ft. radius.

zhCN: 目标的下一次{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}承受 –1 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}；若它本轮攻击除你以外的生物，该{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}变为 –2。
enGB: The target takes a –1 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} on its next {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack roll{/g}, or –2 if it attacks anyone but you this round.

zhCN: 目标移动至 10 尺内可见的空格。该移动不引发{g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}借机攻击{/g}，不能穿越实体障碍。
enGB: The target moves up to 10 ft. to a visible square. Provokes no {g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

zhCN: 目标在{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级（AC）{/g}上获得 +2 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，在所有{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上获得 +1 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。
enGB: Targets gain a +2 insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and a +1 insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on all {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}.

zhCN: 目标移动速度获得 +10 尺不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}（10 级起 +20 尺），并对{g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}借机攻击{/g}获得 +4 闪避{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g} AC。
enGB: Targets gain a +10-foot untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to speed (+20 feet at 10th level) and a +4 dodge {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} against {g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}attacks of opportunity{/g}.

zhCN: 目标在{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级（AC）{/g}与所有{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上承受 –2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。
enGB: The target takes a –2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and on all {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}.

zhCN: 目标获得一次博士圣疗的{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}效果（可附加慈悲）。该指令不能伤害不死生物。
enGB: The target gains the Doctor's lay on hands healing (mercies apply); cannot harm undead.

zhCN: 友军攻击目标时忽略由{g|ConditionInvisible}隐形{/g}、镜影或掩蔽产生的失手几率。这不移除上述效果。
enGB: Allies ignore the target's miss chance from invisibility, mirror images, or concealment.

zhCN: 一架医疗无人机跟随目标友军；每轮开始时，该友军恢复 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} + {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}（至多 +5）点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}。
enGB: A medical drone follows the target ally, healing {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} + {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} (max +5) at the start of each round.

zhCN: 结束目标身上的动摇、恐惧与恐慌；其{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与武器伤害获得 +1 不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}（10 级起 +2）。
enGB: Ends {g|ConditionShaken}shaken{/g}, {g|ConditionFrightened}frightened{/g} and {g|ConditionFrightened}panicked{/g} on the targets. Targets gain a +1 untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on attack and weapon damage rolls (+2 at 10th level).

zhCN: 目标{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与武器伤害获得 +2 不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}（伤害每 4 级再 +1）。每轮开始时，目标失去 2 点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}，但不会因此降至 1 点以下。
enGB: +2 untyped attack and damage (+1 per 4 levels); loses 2 {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} each round (not below 1).

zhCN: 目标陷入{g|ConditionSlowed}缓慢{/g}状态，如同{g|ConditionSlowed}缓慢{/g}术。
enGB: The target is {g|ConditionSlowed}slowed{/g}, as the slow spell.

zhCN: 区域提供{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}（20% 失手几率）；友军可正常视物。
enGB: The area grants concealment (20% miss chance); allies see through it normally.

zhCN: 在地面放置一枚炸弹：每轮开始时，炸弹 10 尺内有敌人就爆炸，在 10 尺爆发内造成 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} 点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}火焰伤害{/g}与 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} 点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}；你也可以用{g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}自由动作{/g}手动引爆。
enGB: You place a bomb on the ground: at the start of each round it explodes if an enemy is within 10 feet, dealing {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}fire damage{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}bludgeoning damage{/g} in a 10-foot burst. You may also detonate it as a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g}.

zhCN: 目标不能施展法术，也不能使用类法术能力或超自然能力；该效果不妨碍被动能力。
enGB: 目标不能施展法术，也不能使用类法术能力或超自然能力；该效果不妨碍被动能力。

zhCN: 目标进行整轮攻击时可额外进行一次全力攻击{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}的攻击；{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g} +1（不具类型），{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级（AC）{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g} +1（闪避），所有移动速度 +30 尺（不具类型）。各项均可与加速术叠加。
enGB: The target gains one extra attack at its full base attack {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on a full attack; a +1 untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}; a +1 dodge {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and Reflex saves; and a +30-foot untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to all speeds. Every part stacks with haste.

zhCN: 区域内敌人每 2 个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}受到 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} 点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}挥砍伤害{/g}（最多 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d6{/g}）。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}失败的敌人还会{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g} 1 轮。
enGB: {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}slashing damage{/g} per 2 levels (max {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d6{/g}); failures are dazed 1 round.

zhCN: 区域内敌人速度减半、{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}所有豁免{/g}承受 −2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}；友军每轮开始恢复 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g} 点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}。敌人离开区域后其效果结束。
enGB: Enemies: half speed, –2 saves; allies regain {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} each round.

zhCN: 区域内敌人 AC、{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}各 −1，且每轮只能做一个动作（不能做{g|Encyclopedia:Full_Round_Action}整轮动作{/g}）；每轮开始时可再次豁免，成功则解除。
enGB: Enemies in the area take −1 on {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}, Reflex saves and {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}, and can take only a single move or standard action each round (no {g|Encyclopedia:Full_Round_Action}full-round action{/g}s); a new save each round ends it.

zhCN: 直线内敌人每级受到 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} 点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}火焰伤害{/g}（最多 {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d6{/g}）。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}失败的敌人火焰抗性降低 10 点。
enGB: Enemies in the line take {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}fire damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} (maximum {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d6{/g}). A creature that fails its Reflex save loses 10 fire resistance for 1 round per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}.

zhCN: 你的下一次近战命中若目标当前{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}不高于其最大值的一半，则该次武器伤害骰翻倍；额外精准伤害不翻倍。触发后法术结束。
